"Why, the time those Indians charged our cave, and Joe and I, and Munson and his crowd were getting ready to fire point-blank at them, there you stood, with bullets whizzing near you more than once, grinding away at the handle of your moving picture camera as hard as you could.

arxiv-1606-02643.title: Model Checking Flat Freeze LTL on One-Counter Automata
arxiv-1606-02643.creator: Antonia Lechner \rsuper 1, Richard Mayr \rsuper 2, Joël Ouaknine \rsuper 3, Amaury Pouly \rsuper 3, James Worrell \rsuper 4
arxiv-1606-02643.description: Abstract . Freeze LTL is a temporal logic with registers that is suitable for specifying properties of data words. In this paper we study the model checking problem for Freeze LTL on one-counter automata. This problem is known to be undecidable in general and PSPACE-complete for the special case of deterministic one-counter automata.

arxiv-1606-04599.title: Mega Key Authentication Mechanism
arxiv-1606-04599.creator: Mega Limited, Auckland, New Zealand, Guy Kloss <gk@mega.nz>
arxiv-1606-04599.description: Abstract name=Listing Chapter 0 Mega Key Authentication Mechanism For secure communication it is not just sufficient to use strong cryptography with good and strong keys, but to actually have the assurance, that the keys in use for it are authentic and from the contact one is expecting to communicate with.

arxiv-1903-02894.title: Open-Boundary Conditions in the Deconfined Phase Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-1903-02894.creator: Adrien Florio e1,addr1, Olaf Kaczmarek e2,addr2,addr3, Lukas Mazur e3,addr3
arxiv-1903-02894.description: Abstract In this work, we consider open-boundary conditions at high temperatures, as they can potentially be of help to measure the topological susceptibility. In particular, we measure the extent of the boundary effects at T = 1.5 ​ T c T=1.5T_{c} and T = 2.7 ​ T c T=2.7T_{c} .

arxiv-1905-05646.title: Finite automata, probabilistic method, and occurrence enumeration of a pattern in words and permutations
arxiv-1905-05646.creator: Toufik Mansour, Reza Rastegar, Alexander Roitershtein
arxiv-1905-05646.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Toufik Mansour, Reza Rastegar, Alexander Roitershtein. The main theme of this paper is the enumeration of the occurrence of a pattern in words and permutations. We mainly focus on asymptotic properties of the sequence f r v ​ ( k , n ) , f_{r}^{v}(k,n), the number of n n -array k k -ary words that contain a given pattern v v exactly r r times.

arxiv-2201-04449.title: Intra-domain and cross-domain transfer learning for time series data – How transferable are the features?
arxiv-2201-04449.creator: Otović Erik, Njirjak Marko, Jozinović Dario, Mauša Goran, Michelini Alberto, Štajduhar Ivan
arxiv-2201-04449.description: Abstract In practice, it is very demanding and sometimes impossible to collect datasets of tagged data large enough to successfully train a machine learning model, and one possible solution to this problem is transfer learning. This study aims to assess how transferable are the features between different domains of time series data and under which conditions.

arxiv-2206-08976.title: Sensitivity of non-Hermitian systems
arxiv-2206-08976.creator: Elisabet Edvardsson, Eddy Ardonne
arxiv-2206-08976.description: Abstract Understanding the extreme sensitivity of the eigenvalues of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians to the boundary conditions is of great importance when analyzing non-Hermitian systems, as it appears generically and is intimately connected to the skin effect and the breakdown of the conventional bulk boundary correspondence.

arxiv-2208-13905.title: A review of transcranial magnetic stimulation and Alzheimer’s disease
arxiv-2208-13905.creator: Arsalan Heidarpanah
arxiv-2208-13905.description: Abstract Since four decades ago, that the transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) technique was introduced, the increasing attention of neuroscience researchers and medical engineers has been focused on the development of this technique and its use to manage the treatment of a wide range of neurological conditions, including Alzheimer’s disease.

arxiv-2210-10222.title: DEM-Simulation of thin elastic membranes interacting with a granulate Journal: Granular Matter
arxiv-2210-10222.creator: Holger Götz, Thorsten Pöschel
arxiv-2210-10222.description: Abstract For a wide range of applications, we need DEM simulations of granular matter in contact with elastic flexible boundaries. We present a novel method to describe the interaction between granular particles and a flexible elastic membrane. Here, the standard mass-spring model approach is supplemented by surface patches given by a triangulation of the membrane.

arxiv-2212-00481.title: A Survey of Mobile Edge Computing for the Metaverse: Architectures, Applications, and Challenges
arxiv-2212-00481.creator: Yitong Wang yitong.wang@ntu.edu.sg, Jun Zhao junzhao@ntu.edu.sg
arxiv-2212-00481.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yitong Wang yitong.wang@ntu.edu.sg, Jun Zhao junzhao@ntu.edu.sg. Metaverse is an emerging virtual universe where humans can have real-time interactions and solid social links like in the physical world, and it opens up a new era of Internet and interactions. In Metaverse, an immersive and photorealistic environment promotes social activities, including education, meetings, and shopping of digital avatars based on critical technologies, including 3D rendering, extended reality, digital twins, artificial intelligence, and Blockchain.

arxiv-2301-06114.title: Segmenting thalamic nuclei from manifold projections of multi-contrast MRI
arxiv-2301-06114.creator: Chang Yan, Muhan Shao, Zhangxing Bian, Anqi Feng, Yuan Xue, Jiachen Zhuo, Rao P. Gullapalli, Aaron Carass, Jerry L. Prince
arxiv-2301-06114.description: Abstract The thalamus is a subcortical gray matter structure that plays a key role in relaying sensory and motor signals within the brain. Its nuclei can atrophy or otherwise be affected by neurological disease and injuries including mild traumatic brain injury.

arxiv-2407-02861.title: A Self-Supervised Task for Fault Detection in Satellite Multivariate Time Series
arxiv-2407-02861.creator: Carlo Cena, Silvia Bucci, Alessandro Balossino, Marcello Chiaberge
arxiv-2407-02861.description: Abstract In the space sector, due to environmental conditions and restricted accessibility, robust fault detection methods are imperative for ensuring mission success and safeguarding valuable assets. This work proposes a novel approach leveraging Physics-Informed Real NVP neural networks, renowned for their ability to model complex and high-dimensional distributions, augmented with a self-supervised task based on sensors’ data permutation.

arxiv-2410-18141.title: SmartRAG: Jointly Learn RAG-Related Tasks From the Environment Feedback
arxiv-2410-18141.creator: Jingsheng Gao § \lx@sectionsign, Linxu Li, Ke Ji, Weiyuan Li, Yixin Lian, Yuzhuo Fu, Bin Dai
arxiv-2410-18141.description: Abstract RAG systems consist of multiple modules to work together. However, these modules are usually separately trained. We argue that a system like RAG that incorporates multiple modules should be jointly optimized to achieve optimal performance. To demonstrate this, we design a specific pipeline called SmartRAG that includes a policy network and a retriever.

arxiv-2503-15734.title: Uncertainty Estimators for Robust Backup Control Barrier Functions
arxiv-2503-15734.creator: DAVID E. J. VAN WIJK 1, ERSIN DAŞ 2, ANIL ALAN 3, SAMUEL COOGAN 4, TAMAS G. MOLNAR 5, JOEL W. BURDICK 1, MANORANJAN MAJJI 6, KERIANNE L. HOBBS 7
arxiv-2503-15734.description: Abstract Designing safe controllers is crucial and notoriously challenging for input-constrained safety-critical control systems. Backup control barrier functions offer an approach for the construction of safe controllers online by considering the flow of the system under a backup controller. However, in the presence of model uncertainties, the flow cannot be accurately computed, making this method insufficient for safety assurance.

arxiv-2507-03409.title: Lessons from a Chimp: AI ‘Scheming’ and the Quest for Ape Language
arxiv-2507-03409.creator: Christopher Summerfield, Lennart Luettgau, Magda Dubois, Hannah Rose Kirk, Kobi Hackenburg, Catherine Fist, Katarina Slama, Nicola Ding, Rebecca Anselmetti, Andrew Strait, Mario Giulianelli, Cozmin Ududec
arxiv-2507-03409.description: Abstract We examine recent research that asks whether current AI systems may be developing a capacity for ‘scheming’ (covertly and strategically pursuing misaligned goals). We compare current research practices in this field to those adopted in the 1970s to test whether non-human primates could master natural language.

pmc-10674186.creator: Lijun Zhao, Donald K. Ingram, Eric Gumpricht, Trent De Paoli, Xiao Tong Teong, Bo Liu, Trevor A. Mori, Leonie K. Heilbronn, George S. Roth
pmc-10674186.description: Background: Unripe avocados (Persea americana) are naturally enriched in mannoheptulose (MH), which is a candidate caloric restriction mimetic. pmc-10714903.title: Self-Reported Pain Treatment Practices Among U.S. and Canadian Adults: Findings From a Population Survey
pmc-10714903.creator: Anna Zajacova, Alvaro Pereira Filho, Merita Limani, Hanna Grol-Prokopczyk, Zachary Zimmer, Dmitry Scherbakov, Roger B Fillingim, Mark D Hayward, Ian Gilron, Gary J Macfarlane, Cary Reid
pmc-10714903.description: Background and ObjectivesPain treatments and their efficacy have been studied extensively. Yet surprisingly little is known about the types of treatments, and combinations of treatments, that community-dwelling adults use to manage pain, as well as how treatment types are associated with individual characteristics and national-level context.

pmc-11434673.title: Botany, Traditional Use, Phytochemistry, Pharmacology and Quality Control of Taraxaci herba: Comprehensive Review
pmc-11434673.creator: Jianhao Wu, Jialin Sun, Meiqi Liu, Xiaozhuang Zhang, Lingyang Kong, Lengleng Ma, Shan Jiang, Xiubo Liu, Wei Ma
pmc-11434673.description: Taraxaci herba, as a traditional Chinese medicine, is the name of the Taraxacum genus in the Asteraceae family. Documented in the Tang Herbal Medicine (Tang Dynasty, AD 657–659), its medicinal properties cover a wide range of applications such as acute mastitis, lung abscess, conjunctival congestion, sore throat, damp-heat jaundice, and vision improvement.

pmc-12427717.title: Bromelain in Obesity Therapy: A Review of Anti-Inflammatory and Metabolic Mechanisms
pmc-12427717.creator: Yashvi Sethia, Ewelina Polak-Szczybyło, Jacek Tabarkiewicz, Andrey Marchev, Nikolina Mihaylova
pmc-12427717.description: The increasing prevalence of obesity, a chronic disease, necessitates the development and evaluation of evidence-based prevention and intervention strategies tailored to heterogeneous populations. Certain fruits, including papaya and pineapple (Ananas comosus), have been investigated as potential dietary components in obesity management.

pmc-12655501.title: Hydrazine Intercalation into 2D MoTe2 Field Effect Transistor as Charge Trapping Sites for Nonvolatile Memory Applications
pmc-12655501.creator: Li Yuan, Yongyu Wu, Haohui Ou, Di Wu, Yuhan Ji, Dianyu Qi, Wenjing Zhang, Carlo Mariani
pmc-12655501.description: Driven by the demands of artificial intelligence, big data and the Internet of Things, non-volatile memory has become the cornerstone of modern computing. However, at present, most of the preparation processes are quite complex and have high requirements for the materials. Here, we discovered that hydrazine (N2H4) molecules can be efficiently intercalated into the MoTe2, acting as stable charge-trapping centers.

pmc-13210907.title: Synthesis of Amphiphilic Polyether-Modified Silicone Oil Polymers and the Application of Their Micelles in Enhancing the Overall Waterproofing and Corrosion Resistance of Cement-Based Concrete Materials
pmc-13210907.creator: Yujie Luo, Fen Zhou, Shuangping Ma, Depeng Gong, Zhanbo Wang, Xi Li, Chaocan Zhang
pmc-13210907.description: In this study, a series of amphiphilic polyether-modified silicone oil (PMSO) polymers with hydrophilic–lipophilic balance (HLB) values ranging from 3.5 to 5 were synthesized via hydrosilylation. These polymers are self-emulsifying and can form stable micelles in water without the need for external emulsifiers, with micelle sizes ranging from 79.9 to 161.4 nm.

pmc-13449608.creator: Rachel L Hawkins, Kimberly Butler, Fiona C Sampson, Alan J Lobo, Daniel Hind
pmc-13449608.description: BackgroundAccess to healthcare may be driving unplanned and potentially avoidable hospital admissions for people diagnosed with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Interventions to reduce unplanned and potentially avoidable admissions need to be developed based on a clear conceptual framework that identifies the system-level access barriers contributing to these admissions.

pmc-13634219.title: Association of Neutrophil-to-Lymphocyte Ratio and Monocyte-to-Lymphocyte Ratio With Symptom Severity and Subjective Well-Being in Schizophrenia: A Cross-Sectional Study From Central India
pmc-13634219.creator: Rashmi Meena, Ragini Meena, Jiwan S Meena, Rajendra Nigam, Jaiprakash Agarwal, Ramgopal Baghel
pmc-13634219.description: Background: Systemic inflammation has increasingly been implicated in schizophrenia. The neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) and monocyte-to-lymphocyte ratio (MLR), derived from routine complete blood count (CBC) investigations, are inexpensive inflammatory indices, but Indian data relating them to symptom severity and subjective well-being remain limited.
